In 威名大震, this is an ordinary compositional sequence rather than a standalone expression; grouping it hides the useful adverb 大 and verb 震.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 大 (“greatly”) and 震 (“resound; become widely known”) while keeping 威名 separate.
